description_en: Creates or updates a user group in Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用DsgUserGroupAddOrUpdate接口，新增或编辑数据保护伞中的用户组
name: DsgUserGroupAddOrUpdate

fields.help_en:
The users in the user group.

For user groups created based on Alibaba Cloud accounts and Resource Access Management (RAM) roles, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786445.html API to query the user list.

For user groups created based on MaxCompute roles, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2785695.html API to query the user list
fields.help_zh:
用户组中的用户列表。
基于阿里云账号及RAM角色创建的用户组：可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786445.html接口查询用户列表。
基于MaxCompute角色创建的用户组：可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2785695.html接口查询用户列表
fields.name: accounts

fields.help_en:
The ID of the user group.

If you do not specify this parameter, a new user group is created.

If you specify this parameter, the specified user group is modified. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786441.html operation to query the ID of the user group
fields.help_zh:
用户组ID。
不配置该参数：表示当前操作为新增用户组。
配置该参数：表示编辑指定用户组信息。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786441.html接口查询用户组ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The name of the user group
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The owner of the user group
fields.name: owner

fields.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project. Set this parameter when you create a MaxCompute user group
fields.help_zh: MaxCompute项目名称。创建MaxCompute用户组时必须配置该参数
fields.name: project_name

fields.help_en:
The type of the user group. The following values are valid:

1: Alibaba Cloud user

2: RAM Role

3: MaxCompute Role
fields.help_zh:
用户组类型。取值如下：
1：阿里云用户
2：RAM角色
3：MaxCompute角色
fields.name: user_group_type
